text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf juggles grueling training 
with student council duties. Her 
right-hand girl, Vice President Air 
Groove, looks on with concern.

Fellow Vice President Narita Brian was 
brusque, but she also showed a side of 
herself that cared for the new Student 
Council general affairs staff.

Symboli Rudolf stated that having those 
who follow her was encouraging. It was a 
day that offered a rare glimpse into her 
feelings for the student council members.
